_comment: Fable's Sentry target registry. Edit this file to add a watch target; the server and UI both read it, so nothing is hardcoded in two places. 'identity' is the string that MUST appear in the response body — a port being open is NOT health. That rule exists because on 2026-08-28 Redis was LISTENING on 6379 while answering MISCONF and refusing all writes, and every port-only check called it green for hours.

targets.label: Redis
targets.note: Probed with PING expecting PONG. A MISCONF reply means writes are disabled even though the port is open.

targets.label: Obsidian (Local REST API)
targets.note: Sync vault C:\ANTIGRAVITY\Antigravity. Served by the obsidian-local-rest-api community plugin (HTTP 27123, HTTPS 27124). No heal: Obsidian is a desktop app Joshua opens; DOWN means the app or the plugin is not running, WRONG SERVICE means something else took the port. The root route answers without auth and names the service, which is the identity check.

targets.label: OmniRoute gateway
targets.note: Bots route here. Hermes default stays on Nous / auth sign-in models. Identity = the model catalog answering (the built-in combo id must appear). Changed from a port check 2026-09-03: the server child hit ~3 GB working set, /models went from 18 s to a 60 s timeout, completions died, and the port stayed open the whole time — an open port is not health.

targets.label: Hermes gateway (paperclip-mc)
targets.note: Serves /health, NOT /api/health, on build 0.20.5. A check against /api/health reports a healthy gateway as down.

groups.name: CRM + data

targets.label: CRM (hosted, WORKING)
targets.note: The emergent-hosted copy of the SAME CRM code. This one has live data (100 leads, 29 hot). The local :3001 copy renders an identical shell with NO stat cards and a DISABLED Refresh button, because its MongoDB cannot start on this CPU. Both return HTTP 200 -- which is exactly why a status code is not a health check.

targets.label: MongoDB (CRM)
targets.note: BLOCKED, not merely down. mongod 8.0.29 dies at 'Initializing durable catalog' with 0xC000001D STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION. This CPU is an i7-4960X (Ivy Bridge-E): it has AVX but NOT AVX2. The bundled MongoDB cannot run on this hardware at any config. Fix = install a MongoDB build that does not require AVX2, or move the CRM off Mongo. No FIX button, because no restart can help.

groups.note: crmui :3001 / crmapi :8001 retired from the wall 2026-09-03 — the CRM was folded into the monorepo 08-26 and the hosted instance is the live one; two permanent reds for services nobody starts is noise, not health.

targets.label: dream-online.net
targets.note: Registered with the hyphen. On IONOS parking until the Cloudflare zone + landing page deploy land (docs/ops/DNS-NAMESERVER-PLAN.md). RED here is the truth until then.

targets.label: untilnokidinneed.com
targets.note: Stray A record to a Cloudflare IP with no zone behind it (error 1001) as of 2026-09-03.

targets.label: Open Collective · dream-online
targets.note: Live 2026-09-03: hosted by the LLC, 4 tiers. Identity = the collective name in the page.

targets.label: Buzz relay (node ledger)
targets.note: The cross-node record (ops/buzz/). Root answers NIP-11 JSON naming the relay; that is the identity.

targets.label: OmniRoute on the LAN (192.168.0.8)
targets.note: What other nodes see. DOWN until the inbound firewall rule for 20128/20129 exists — bound 0.0.0.0, no rule (verified 2026-09-03). Loopback row above can be UP while this is DOWN; both are true.
